description: minimumReleaseAge holds every update back for 5 days. Both upstreams this
family of wrappers depends on have shipped releases that were broken on
arrival and fixed days later: obsidian-sync-mcp 0.6.4 broke every session
for current Claude clients and was superseded in 1 day, and
@delorenj/mcp-server-trello 1.8.0 published a package that could not start
and was fixed in 4 days. A 5-day soak would have skipped both.
